params.branch: 17-adic eigensystem of Delta-type (T_2 = -24, T_3 = 252 mod 17), k = 12 mod 16

conventions.alpha: alpha(x, y) = dg_1 x - dg_p y
conventions.alpha_star: alpha*(z) = (omega z, -omega' z), omega = cor^{SL_2(Z)}_{Gamma_0(p)}, omega' = kappa^{-1} o cor^{G_2}_{Gamma_0(p)}
conventions.alpha_star_alpha: alpha*alpha = [[p+1, -T_p], [-p^{2-k} T_p, p+1]] on H^1(SL_2(Z), V)^2
conventions.T_q: classical T_q (no p^{k/2-1} twist); HACS free block F in the column convention T b_j = sum_i F_ij b_i
conventions.s03_form: s03 (code/results/s03/C3_rerun.json): [[q+1, -q^{2-k} T_q], [-T_q, q+1]] = J (alpha*alpha) J, J = [[0,1],[1,0]] (block swap); same determinant and isomorphic cokernel (both computed and compared per k)
conventions.rho_n: column j of rho_n(A) holds the coefficients of (ax+cy)^{n-j}(bx+dy)^j in the basis x^{n-t}y^t

data.localisation: m = (17, T_2 + 24, T_3 - 252, ...): the m-part of L (x) Z_17 is cut out by e_m = e_2(T_2) e_3(T_3), the primary idempotents for the residues tau(2), tau(3) mod 17 (lifted mod 17^E). At every k here e_m = e_{T_3} already (checked: e_T3_equals_e_m), so T_2 plays no role in the localisation; e_{T_2} alone would not suffice (at k = 60 the residue tau(2) has T_2-multiplicity 4 > 2 = rank e_m, see rank_e_T2), but multiplying by it does not change e_{T_3}. At level 1 the T_3-branch has degree 1, so it is one eigenform, of Delta-type by Deligne-Serre applied to Delta * E_16^{(k-12)/16} (E_16 = 1 mod 17). coker(M)_m = coker(M diag(e,e) + 1 - diag(e,e)).
data.ordinary_projector: e = lim T_17^{N!}, computed as T_17^N mod 17^E and checked idempotent. T_17 = tau(17) = 10 mod 17 is a unit on the m-part (checked: T17_unit_on_m_part), so e e_m = e_m (checked): e acts as the identity on the m-part and e coker(Psi*Psi)_m = coker(Psi*Psi)_m.

routes.betti_amalgam: route B, GATING. task1_v6 amalgam.py (imported) + transfer block adapted from cell.py: all four blocks of alpha*alpha as actual composites from cocycles (diagonal checked = q+1); no HACS data
routes.betti_hacs: route A, NOT RUN (module_Z() off by default; Q4: default no, pending Fabian). HACS module_Z() integral T_q on H^1/tors, alpha*alpha in the task1_v6 convention
routes.hecke: HACS descent(...).charpoly only: exact char_Z(T_3) (cusp part), length Z_17[x]/(h, 16*3^{k-2} - x^2); status open if branch degree > 1
routes.t_G_proxy: PARI mf, stage-06 H1 proxy ord_17(a_3^2 - 16*3^{k-2})
